title: Juice N Power Bar Salts  Black Mamba 10ml E-Liquid
description: Black Mamba from the JNP Bar Salts collection offers a dynamic and richly layered tropical fruit experience. The profile opens with the sharp, exotic tang of Passion Fruit layered alongside a sweet, juicy medley of Mixed Berries. To round out the blend, a brisk layer of crisp Mint washes over the palate, ensuring a highly refreshing and complex finish that remains consistently satisfying. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine satisfaction and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the exotic chill of Black Mamba, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the botanical Aloe Vera Grape or the refreshing Watermelon Breeze.
